focus: EIS finite detector adequacy, negative selection, two-signal gating, and bounded diagnostic immunity

scope.source_baseline: Parent-assigned 8050c66900899771766f33e8f5fdd200b7dd9120 plus the in-progress dag audit; repository observations refer to the local files read for this report.
scope.seed_access: Seed contents were not read or solved. A read-only SHA-256 integrity check gave 9941ab91f8e6b6637e49bb364cc0e6451788dd96442afcdb7f7024de042500a7. No private benchmark storage or answer key was accessed.
scope.novelty_claim: These are new proposed compositions for this repository, not literature-wide novelty claims. Negative selection, metamorphic controls, finite coverage optimization, selective prediction, and scoped regulation are established methods or existing repository components.
scope.benchmark_isolation: Future answer-producing calls receive the original UTF-8 seed as a separate unchanged message; round-trip decoding and re-encoding must retain the exact bytes and SHA-256. A seed-free detector-induction call is explicitly marked as such. Instructions, controls and artifacts remain separate from the seed. No key, private label, private score, key-derived example, evaluator diagnostic or key-selected repair hint enters any model call, host rule selection, memory or retrieval corpus. Freeze all candidate outputs before separate trusted evaluation; evaluator feedback never triggers another stage.
scope.calibration_boundary: All controls below come from a separately specified public synthetic grammar, not benchmark answer material. Freeze development, calibration and confirmation partitions before inducing detectors. Selection uses calibration once; confirmation can reject the frozen selection but cannot tune or repair it. If a partition is reused for tuning it is development evidence, and a fresh confirmation partition is required. Public availability does not by itself prevent model pretraining contamination.
scope.single_seed_limit: Repeated runs on one public seed can compare stochastic outcomes for that instance. They cannot establish detector completeness, a general error rate, out-of-distribution immunity, or population-level learning improvement. Tuning on this seed makes it development data; fresh independent tasks are required for generalization claims.
scope.implementation_boundary: No workflow was implemented or run. Proposed AST detector DSLs, confirmation controls, repair routing, memory leases and typed adapters require implementation. Existing EIS activation emits FINDING/HOLD/REFUSE with AuthorityEffect None and does not authorize repair or admit a candidate. Any future repair stage is a separate benchmark scheduler operation. Current guards and native ports must be validated before integration.

primary_sources.title: Forrest, Perelson, Allen and Cherukuri, Self-Nonself Discrimination in a Computer, IEEE S&P 1994
primary_sources.relevance: Primary negative-selection method: screen candidate detectors against self before using retained detectors for change detection. This supports the finite screening design, not a theorem that our learned rules detect all mathematical errors.

primary_sources.title: Chen, Cheung and Yiu, Metamorphic Testing: A New Approach for Generating Next Test Cases, HKUST-CS98-01
primary_sources.relevance: Primary report proposing related follow-up tests to expose failures when full test oracles are unavailable. Motivates benign syntax transformations and paired defect mutations; each proposed relation still needs an independently justified contract.

primary_sources.title: El-Yaniv and Wiener, On the Foundations of Noise-free Selective Classification, JMLR 2010
primary_sources.relevance: Primary treatment of coverage versus risk with a reject option. Motivates measuring diagnostic coverage and errors together. Its distributional results do not transfer to a single mathematical seed or finite hand-designed controls without their assumptions.

primary_sources.title: OpenRouter Models API documentation
primary_sources.relevance: Documents per-token/request/unit pricing fields, possible pricing overrides, supported parameters and completion limits. Every future run must pin current endpoint metadata and reserve every billable component; this report does not quote a current model price.

repository_evidence.observation: Audit coverage is distinct from evaluation; seed bytes are immutable; key evaluation is separate; paid runs require aggregate USD 0.10 reservations.

Audit bounds exact EIS thresholds and declared correlation support; warns that fixture success is not detector completeness. It also records a tolerance-equality/hash mismatch in DetectorRule and Signal1Match, so proposed registries use canonical byte digests rather than those objects as set keys.

evaluate_rule forces active screening, binds the actual matcher, and tests every self fixture. Passing means no hit on those fixtures only. The proposed adequate-set selection adds defect sensitivity and untouched confirmation, which this screen alone does not establish.

Activation requires admission, detector match, host danger and no suspension; model danger, common evidence and subject mismatch are rejected. Receipt distinctions are structural safeguards, not statistical independence. Dispositions exclude repair and admission.

The operational path obtains custody externally, calls a host DangerSensor on the subject bytes, uses native activation, and requires authenticated host health. The low-level Boolean law is not the complete deployment trust boundary.

Hill activation is an exact monotone sum threshold. A per-sensor cap gives a lower bound on distinct positive names, not independent observations or truth. The proposed workflows do not treat quorum as a correctness certificate.

Support deduplicates occurrences and declared provenance, rejects propagated references, and computes exact MIS for at most 32 deduplicated observations. Missing correlation edges remain an epistemic limitation.

Existing scoped guidance chooses at most three signatures above an execution-error threshold, requiring a reproducer and non-triggered benign control. It is candidate-only and does not request activation. The third proposal adds freshness, paired transfer controls and abstention.

Regulation can narrow only selected optional guards within a bounded scope. Independent benign checks are subject-bound; unavailable checks cannot establish benignity; protected gates cannot be suspended.
A benign-hit threshold emits a proposal and leaves is_suspended false. Repetition alone does not supply evidence or authorize suspension.

Finite controls do not give a population rate; telemetry without TN cannot yield FP/(FP+TN); observer independence and detector completeness remain open. Clean reports, scores, support and signatures each answer only their declared question.

common_budget_policy.formula: Before dispatch reserve C_max = sum_s(I_s*p_in_s + O_s*p_out_s + Q_s*p_reason_s + F_s) + R <= USD 0.10. I_s covers all instructions, unchanged seed when present, schemas and prior artifacts; O_s covers ordinary output; Q_s covers separately billed reasoning if it is not already included in O_s. Never double-count or omit provider-specific reasoning charges. Any uncapped billable component causes refusal.
common_budget_policy.conditional_example: The per-idea numerical examples assume p_in <= USD 0.000001/token and all billable completion/reasoning tokens together cost <= USD 0.000005/token, with F_s=0 and R=USD 0.01. These are endpoint admission thresholds, not assertions of current OpenRouter or Anthropic prices.
common_budget_policy.routing: Admit a pinned OpenRouter endpoint or direct Anthropic endpoint only after current prices, pricing overrides, tokenization, context limits, output limits and usage semantics fit the envelope. Disable retries, automatic fallback, paid tools, web search and uncapped reasoning. For an unknown price override refuse or reserve a verified upper bound. Reserve the full second call before the first even when conditional. A timeout retains its reservation and unknown usage ends the run.
common_budget_policy.receipts: Store model/provider identity, price timestamp, request hashes, input and output bounds, actual token usage and charged costs. Do not place secrets in receipts. Detector induction in I01 is charged in that run; I02 and I03 use only frozen deterministic public registries, not an unaccounted paid training process.
common_budget_policy.host_compute: Bound controls to 96 per partition, 12 detector candidates, 64 AST nodes per detector, 4096 subset evaluations, and declared per-check memory/time limits. Zero-incremental-cost local checking is assumed; any metered host cost must be added or the run refused. Paid model calls made for this research report: zero.

ideas.name: Dual-panel negative selection with finite defect coverage

mathematical_basis.known_method: Negative selection screens out self-reactive detectors; metamorphic testing supplies related controls; finite set cover selects a bounded family covering declared defect examples.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Have a seed-free model propose at most 12 bounded AST detector rules from public development controls. Test the exact runtime matcher on paired benign and contract-invalid mutations. Select the smallest self-tolerant subset covering every required calibration family; then test that frozen subset once on untouched confirmation controls. Preserve an adequacy vector by family instead of converting panel success into a general correctness score. A second call constructs the task answer with the frozen warning schema, and the host reports hits and uncovered families without issuing a truth verdict.
mathematical_basis.finite_contract: For benign controls B, defect controls M partitioned into nonempty families M_f, and detector set S: FP_B(S)=sum_b 1[exists d in S: d(b)=1]; C_f(S)=sum_m in M_f 1[exists d in S: d(m)=1]/|M_f|. Enumerate subsets of at most 12 rules and lexicographically minimize (|S|, canonical_ids) subject to FP_B(S)=0 and C_f(S)=1 on calibration. No feasible set produces INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE. Confirmation failures produce UNCONFIRMED and no reselection. These are exact finite counts, not distributional bounds.
mathematical_basis.semantic_boundary: Mutation labels mean valid or invalid for the declared artifact contract. Removing a premise or domain guard does not automatically prove the underlying conclusion false. An independently specified checker must establish every label; unknown labels are excluded and recorded. A hit is a diagnostic hypothesis, and silence is NO_FINDING_WITHIN_PANEL.

assumptions: A public typed artifact grammar, finite safe detector DSL and actual matcher exist; arbitrary model-generated executable code is never run.
Development, calibration and confirmation are frozen before induction; partitions separate transformation templates, not merely names or random seeds of the same string.

Possible control families include stale witness binding, missing required premise, unsupported promotion of evidence scope and declared sort mismatch. Each uses contract-valid benign counterparts with lexical overlap.
All host selection is seed-independent. Confirmation details remain offline and cannot become hints to the answer-producing stage.
No adequate detector subset means an ordinary answer with an explicit coverage gap, not a fabricated clean certificate or an unbudgeted detector rewrite.
ideas.hypothesis: At matched total spend, dual-panel selection reduces benign-trigger counts and exposes more declared contract-defect families than self-only negative selection, while avoiding an increase in unsupported certainty in the final answer.
typed_inputs: SeedBytes{utf8_bytes,sha256}; delivered unchanged only to the answer-producing call

stages.instruction: Freeze the public control grammar, three partitions, DSL interpreter and price reservation. Record the seed digest without modifying or incorporating seed content into detector controls.

Using only generic development controls and the supplied DSL, propose at most 12 diagnostic rules with failure-family scopes. Include no solution, truth verdict or authorization field. Do not infer the withheld task or retrieve any benchmark information.

stages.role: Exact finite negative-selection and coverage checker
stages.instruction: Run the actual matcher on calibration, enumerate feasible self-tolerant covering subsets, and choose deterministically. Evaluate the frozen selection on confirmation once. Record all counts and missing families. Never tune on confirmation or turn detector agreement into truth.

Answer the unchanged seed using the public output schema and frozen generic diagnostic predicates. State assumptions and open obligations. Detector controls are not mathematical evidence for your answer. Do not claim panel adequacy proves correctness.

Run selected rules only if confirmed, retain separate deterministic checker outcomes, and render finite scope and coverage gaps. A candidate with no hits receives no global pass. Freeze candidate, receipts and costs before any trusted private evaluation.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Self-panel-only negative selection using the same proposed rules, matcher, model endpoint and aggregate token cap; compare also a fixed generic checklist.
ablations: Select and report on the same partition, explicitly labeled a leakage-positive experimental control
Use all retained rules instead of minimum-cover selection
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Primary host-only endpoints are confirmation FP counts, covered defect families, detection counts and coverage gaps. Separately score frozen task answers for correctness, unsupported certainty and completeness at matched actual spend and a matched cap. Report total denominators, not only FP/(TP+FP). A single seed gives instance-specific outcomes only.

ideas.falsification: Reject the advantage if untouched confirmation benign hits rise, required families remain uncovered, or answer correctness/completeness deteriorates beyond a preregistered tolerance. A detector passing calibration but failing confirmation falsifies its transfer claim, not the correctness of all candidate answers.
risks: Finite grammar defects can be easier than real proof errors; family coverage cannot establish semantic completeness.
Correlated metamorphic variants inflate counts; report template-level results as well as instance counts.
Model and host may share a mistaken control contract. Label-checker adequacy remains explicit.
Reusing confirmation to select another subset creates calibration leakage even if no private answer key is involved.
Induction consumes tokens that could otherwise be spent on the derivation.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 9000*p_in + 3600*p_out + sum(F_s) + R for two calls, no retries; all billable reasoning must fit the completion envelope or be reserved separately. At the common conditional thresholds and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.037.

ideas.name: Subject-bound two-signal repair routing with disagreement controls

mathematical_basis.known_method: Conjunctive guard activation and independent host checks already exist in EIS. Factorial control interventions test that either required input can block a gate. Evidence-carrying local repair is an established verification pattern.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Use a frozen EIS-style detector hit to identify a repair class and a separately executed exact host check to supply a concrete public failure witness about the same claim and candidate hash. Route at most one repair call only when both are present, the optional diagnostic rule is authorized for this research profile, health is current, and the rule is unsuspended. This scheduler action is separate from EIS activation. Validate the routing with all four hit/danger combinations and deliberately mismatched, stale and copied receipts.
mathematical_basis.gate: RouteRepair = ProfileAllowed and D(x) and H(x,w) and SameSubject and FreshBindings and Healthy and not Suspended and BudgetReserved. D and H use different code paths and evidence provenance, but no statistical independence is inferred. H is a failure of a declared public predicate or a checked counterexample, not an LLM opinion. Every deterministic failure is reported even when D(x)=0; the conjunction controls repair allocation, never hides a known failure or certifies the ungated candidate.
mathematical_basis.preservation: A repair must bind to the original candidate hash, change only declared claim IDs and dependent prose, and invalidate/recheck affected receipts. Failed repairs remain failed; successful local predicate checks are reported only for their declared scope. Two passing checkers do not establish theorem truth.

assumptions: A frozen public diagnostic registry and exact host checker exist for at least one declared artifact fragment; unsupported analytic statements remain OPEN.
Danger evidence is produced by the host from public candidate artifacts and allowed rules; no hidden evaluator is callable during the workflow.
A versioned adapter is required if mathematical danger classes are outside the existing EIS closed registry; the proposal does not silently add new signal kinds to the current implementation.
Benchmark routing authorization is stored outside model output and does not create production admission or enforcement authority.
No repair is attempted on a checker infrastructure error, unknown subject binding, stale witness, or missing health evidence.
ideas.hypothesis: Compared with unconditional critique or detector-hit-only repair, two-signal routing spends fewer calls rewriting sound artifacts while preserving visibility of host-detected defects and improving the local repair success per dollar.

stages.instruction: Freeze the diagnostic profile, checker registry and two-call reservation. Keep the exact seed bytes in their own message. Confirm that no private evaluator or key material is reachable.
Produce the requested answer with stable claim IDs and declared public artifacts. State assumptions and missing checks. You cannot supply host danger, activation or admission flags.

stages.role: Independent public checking and repair scheduler
stages.instruction: Run the frozen detector and the separate host checker on the same bound subject. Validate freshness, scope, health and evidence provenance. Record every checker failure. If all routing conjuncts hold, emit one allowlisted public failure class, artifact pointer and public witness reference for repair; otherwise retain the draft and findings.

Only when RouteDecision is REPAIR_ONCE, repair the indicated artifacts and their dependent prose under the original public assumptions. Do not change the seed, checker, scope or unrelated claim IDs. If the failure cannot be repaired, return explicit unresolved obligations. Do not infer private expected answers.

Apply a hash-bound patch only if well formed; recheck changed artifacts and dependencies. If the model stage was skipped retain the draft. Report remaining failures, unsupported checks and local passes separately, freeze all outputs, and reconcile the aggregate reservation. No private evaluation result can cause a retry.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Two-call draft plus unconditional whole-answer critique under the same cap; also compare detector-only and host-failure-only routing to distinguish the added value of the detector.
ablations: Reused detector digest masquerading as danger
Same predicate under two observer names
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: On public synthetic controls exercise D/H = 00,01,10,11 while keeping admission, suspension and health explicit. Measure spurious repair calls, hidden host failures, benign-answer damage, patch success and total cost. Private scoring occurs after all final answers are frozen. Structural separation and agreement are never reported as statistical independence.

ideas.falsification: A routed repair when either required signal is absent, stale or copied falsifies gate correctness. Suppressing a host failure because the detector was silent falsifies the reporting contract. If H-only routing matches or beats the conjunction on defect repair and cost, the extra detector has no demonstrated utility for this setting.
risks: Two-signal routing can miss useful repair opportunities when the detector has low sensitivity; host failures must still remain visible.
Different observer names can conceal common implementation errors. Evidence lineage must record code and data provenance, without claiming causal independence is proven.
Exact local witness failure may reflect a codec or assumption mismatch rather than a false mathematical conclusion.
A local patch can break a distant prose dependency unless dependency rechecking is complete.
Conditional call savings can make equal-cap comparisons unfair; report matched actual spend as well.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 14000*p_in + 4200*p_out + sum(F_s) + R, reserve both calls before dispatch and permit no retries. At common conditional thresholds and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.045; a skipped repair releases its unused reservation only after first-call usage is known.

ideas.name: Expiring diagnostic memory with paired transfer challenges

mathematical_basis.known_method: Scoped failure guidance and optional-guard regulation exist in EIS. Negative selection and metamorphic controls test unwanted cross-reaction. Selective prediction motivates reporting the coverage lost when guidance is withheld rather than rewarding blanket abstention.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Turn each generic diagnostic memory into a content-addressed lease over a precise parser, matcher, public scope and paired witness/benign-control family. Before reuse, the host challenges the entry on frozen transfer variants. A changed dependency, benign hit or failure to detect its own reproducer makes that entry inactive for the run; it cannot silently survive by accumulating more votes. Present at most three active, solution-free obligations to a single answer-producing call. Keep every expired entry and reason in an append-only diagnostic record, and leave production admission untouched.
mathematical_basis.lease_rule: Active(m,x) = ScopeMatch(m,x) and VersionsMatch(m) and not Expired(m) and forall b in B_m: d_m(b)=0 and forall r in R_m: d_m(r)=1, where B_m and R_m are finite public transfer controls not used to choose m. Max age is a preregistered run count or dependency change, not a learned confidence score. Unknown or failed controls give INACTIVE_FOR_RUN, never benignity or correctness.
mathematical_basis.support_and_metrics: Deduplicate evidence by canonical occurrence and lineage keys before selecting memories. An MIS support count can label declared non-overlap only; missing keys imply UNKNOWN_CORRELATION and cannot boost support. Track active guidance coverage, benign-trigger counts, detected control defects, abstentions and task-answer completeness separately. Do not infer a risk bound from the selective-classification literature without its sampling assumptions.
mathematical_basis.distinctive_test: Use adversarially close but contract-valid transformations to distinguish the failure mechanism from its surface wording. Revoke a rule's use within the current run when this public challenge disproves its specificity, then test whether withholding that guidance prevents an otherwise valid answer from being rewritten into error. This is diagnostic-memory control, not autonomous learning or deployment immunity.

assumptions: The initial memory bank is a bounded, deterministic public research registry with reproducers and checker-established benign controls; it contains no seed solution, private score or paid generation hidden outside the run budget.
Scope matching uses a frozen public typed schema. Model-authored claims of scope compatibility are insufficient.
At most 12 memory entries are considered and at most three are injected; deterministic order is fixed before benchmark evaluation.
Control generation preserves declared semantics only where the host has a checked transformation; lexical similarity alone is not a benignity proof.
Withholding optional research guidance never disables protected gates, modifies authenticated production admission, or deletes historical evidence.
ideas.hypothesis: Expiring and transfer-challenged diagnostic memory reduces false guidance and benign-answer damage compared with always-on retrieval, while retaining useful defect reminders on the declared public grammar.

stages.instruction: Freeze public memory entries, deterministic retrieval order, expiry rule, transfer panels and one-call reservation. Reject answer-bearing, private-derived or unbound memories. Preserve the original seed bytes.

stages.role: Finite transfer challenge and scoped anergy
stages.instruction: Check every candidate lease against scope, versions, age and paired transfer controls using the actual matcher. Deduplicate evidence and mark unknown lineage. Inactivate failing optional guidance only for this run; retain entries and receipts. Select at most three active generic obligations without observing private benchmark results.

stages.role: Answer producer with limited diagnostic memory
stages.instruction: Answer the unchanged seed. Treat the supplied generic obligations as reminders to justify your own assumptions, not as facts or proof of correctness. Preserve requested coverage and explicitly state unsupported claims. Do not invent activation, custody, health or memory-promotion receipts.

Run public checks, record which reminders were used and all unresolved findings, then freeze answer and cost receipts. A quiet detector panel is only no observed finding. Do not promote memory, change admission or request a repair from private evaluation feedback.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Always-on retrieval of the same top-three public entries using the same one-call model and token cap; compare no memory as a second baseline.
ablations: Count duplicated or inherited reports as new support
Expire all entries, to expose apparent gains caused only by withholding guidance
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Use public paired tasks from a fixed grammar to measure guidance-induced errors, reminders that catch their declared defects, abstention and completeness. Include code-version changes and renamed syntax that preserve the control contract. Frozen benchmark outputs may be scored separately, but their feedback cannot enter this memory bank. One seed supports no claim of durable immunity.

ideas.falsification: The proposal fails if expired or scope-mismatched guidance reaches the model, if a known benign-triggering rule stays active, if an inherited duplicate increases independent-support claims, or if transfer challenges remove useful guidance without improving correctness or benign preservation at comparable coverage.
risks: Overly narrow leases can disable most guidance; blanket inactivity can look safe while providing no utility.
Public transfer controls can be overfit through repeated policy changes; policy tuning requires fresh confirmation families.
Scope/parser drift may be semantic even when version hashes are unchanged; hashes identify bytes, not meaning.
A detector passing every pair can still be wrong outside that finite grammar.
A registry that later incorporates evaluator-derived failures would contaminate subsequent benchmark runs; it must remain isolated.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 9500*p_in + 3000*p_out + F_1 + R for one call, no retries and no hidden paid memory construction. At common conditional thresholds and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.0345.

recommended_reusable_primitive.name: FiniteDetectorAdequacyLeaseV1
recommended_reusable_primitive.recommendation: Implement a host-owned receipt joining actual-matcher identity, finite positive/negative control counts, independent host-evidence bindings and scoped expiry before adding any adaptive repair or memory policy.
recommended_reusable_primitive.invariant: Only host code issues counts and statuses. A detector hit, panel agreement, signature or support count cannot set a global correctness bit. No-hit, unknown, checker error and scoped pass remain distinct. A second signal must be bound to the same current subject with separately executed host evidence; distinct names alone never establish independence. Dependencies or control partitions changing invalidates the lease. No private benchmark feedback enters any field.
recommended_reusable_primitive.research_prompt_instruction: Design the finite detector DSL, paired public control grammar, immutable partition protocol and FiniteDetectorAdequacyLeaseV1 serializer. Propose deterministic tests for benign transformations, defect-family omissions, copied evidence, stale subject hashes, matcher drift and duplicate lineage. Keep every instruction generic and solution-free. Do not solve or rewrite any benchmark seed, read private benchmark storage, access an answer key or infer expected answers from evaluator diagnostics. Preserve seed bytes as a separate immutable artifact.
recommended_reusable_primitive.first_experiment: Host-only controls validate no vacuous inactive-rule pass, all four detector/danger combinations, stale-hash rejection and lease invalidation. Then a future authorized one-call R02-I03 pilot can compare frozen guidance with no memory. No such implementation or paid pilot was performed for this report.
